summary.motive: Present an ambiguous 2-high shell pre-snap, then split the field into Quarters to the passing strength and Cover 2 to the boundary to suffocate vertical seams and intermediate outs.
summary.keyDefender: Field Safety (FS) matching #2 seam and Boundary CB (LCB) playing cloud squat on the flat
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses expect traditional Cover 2 or single-high Cover 3; split-field Cover 6 eliminates the field seam without leaving the boundary corner isolated 1-on-1.
summary.failureMode: Boundary smash route if the safety fails to get over top of the corner squat in time, or interior run if offense checks to draw against the 1-linebacker box.

beats.title: Static Two-High Pre-Snap Disguise
beats.text: Fangio aligns in an unmistakable two-high shell with safeties deep at 12 yards and a light Penny 5-1-5 front, disguising whether the coverage is Quarters, Cover 6, or Cover 8.

beats.title: Field Quarters Clamps the Seam
beats.text: At the snap, Field Safety FS instantly reads Y vertical and clamps his inside hip in Quarters match, while RCB locks down Z on the outside.

beats.title: Boundary Cloud Collision & Flat Trap
beats.text: LCB reroutes X into the boundary and squats on H in the flat, while Boundary Safety BS ranges to the deep half to erase the sideline hole shot.

beats.title: Quarterback Hesitation & Pocket Collapse
beats.text: With the field seam clamped and boundary flat suffocated, the QB double-clutches as ROLB bends the edge for a drive-ending sack.

relations.tell: Base split-safety structure: Field safety matches slot seam in Quarters while Boundary safety rolls to deep half.
